==Product codes== The ''617661400140'' UPC covers the Model 9990 '''Aviator 2.4''' Wireless Network Kit. Hardware wise, it includes two PCMCIA cards and an ISA PC Card adapter. ==Images== [[File:WebGear Aviator top.jpg|600px]] [[File:WebGear Aviator bot.jpg|600px]] [[Has images::external| ]]
